concerns.text: T008 (schema validators) is marked [X] complete and depends on T008a-c, yet T008a-c are marked 'rejected' (missing). A consumer task (T008) cannot be complete if its producer tasks (T008a-c) are missing. T008a-c must precede T008.

T015b (validation gate) is marked [X] complete, but it depends on T015 (validation script) which is not marked complete, and T015 depends on T011/T012 (generators) which are marked 'rejected'. The validation gate cannot exist before the data generation and validation logic are implemented.

T023 (training loop) is marked [X] complete and explicitly requires T022 (parity_checker) as a dependency, yet T022 is marked 'rejected' (missing). Additionally, T020 (CoevolvingAgent) is 'rejected' but is a prerequisite for the training logic in T023. Producers must precede consumers.

T034 (full CLI orchestration) is marked [X] complete, but it requires the full pipeline (generation, training, analysis) to function. T026 (evaluation logic) and T027 (statistical analysis) are marked 'rejected'. The orchestration task cannot be complete if the core analysis components it orchestrates are missing.

T013 (held-out test instance generator) is marked 'rejected', yet T026 (evaluation logic) and T031 (retention rate calculation) depend on `data/test_instances.json` produced by T013. The test data producer must precede the evaluation consumers.
T029 (batch runner) is marked 'rejected', but T030 (data aggregation) depends on its output (`data/results/run_*/final_metrics.json`). The batch runner must precede the aggregation logic.
